name: Owaranai Akumu ~Netorare Loop~
original_name: 終わらない悪夢～寝取られループ～
source:
Hidehito Tsukui moved to Tokyo this spring to attend college and was starting a new life.
By his side was his childhood friend, Chiho Hashima, who also moved to Tokyo with him.

One day, when Chiho came over to Hidehito’s place, she made a move on him,
but he rejected her out of fear that their relationship would be ruined.
However, shortly after that, perhaps having given up on Hidehito,
Chiho began dating Yuusei Takasuga, a senior at the university and the leader of the club she belonged to.

Although surprised, Hidehito had been suppressing his feelings,
but by chance, he happened to see a video of the moment Chiho lost her virginity to Yuusei.
At that moment, he realized for the first time that he had been in love with Chiho as a woman, and he was overcome with intense regret.
If only he could start over—

But when Hidehito woke up the next time, he realized—for some reason—that he had been transported back a few days.
He didn’t know how this had happened.
But determined not to repeat the same mistake, Hidehito confessed his love to Chiho himself, and they became a couple.

Hidehito and Chiho were finally a couple.
However, their happiness was short-lived.
Chiho was taken from him once again.
Will Hidehito be able to put an end to this recurring nightmare…?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ014551.html/]dlsite[/url]]
